summary.intent: Diagnose and fix a failing SDK test on CI for PR #615, referenced by a CI run/job URL.
summary.outcome: Identified the failure as a stale test fixture in owner-reconcile.test.ts that still expected the old encoding, confirmed production code intentionally switched to hex, updated the test expectations, verified the full SDK suite passes (427 tests, matching CI's count), and committed/pushed the fix to the PR branch.

repo: sdk-core's re-mint code intentionally encodes as hex now; owner-reconcile.test.ts had stale fixture expectations from before that change.

code.finding: Test fixtures asserted a non-hex encoding that no longer matches sdk-core's re-mint output; updated to expect hex to match current production behavior.

workflow: sdk-core must be rebuilt before re-running SDK tests that depend on it, otherwise stale build output masks source changes.
Before pushing a fix to a PR branch, fetch and diff against remote first to check for bot/release commits and avoid clobbering them.
Commit signing goes through 1Password on this machine, so commits must run unsandboxed with a timeout guard rather than in the default sandboxed mode.
